row.title: KGRAPH-1: one shared knowledge-graph engine for every system
row.body: Every system runs seed/worker/src/knowledge.js on its own clock: incremental D1 sync with provenance, graph analytics and insights whose outcomes calibrate the insight kinds. The platform tick step knowledge covers items, objectives and metrics; tenants vendor the engine (Unlearn first). Research is code: KG_PRACTICES re-measured at /api/graph/method.
